papers.title: Page from a log
lines: The Bounty is burned. The island is ours, and so are its troubles.
We have a stream, a garden and a lookout. The lookout has seen nothing, which is as it should be.

papers.title: Beekeeper's note
lines: The Pitcairn honey is some of the finest in the world, because the bees have never met a disease.
They have, however, met a very opinionated visitor. We are on good terms with both.

papers.title: Supply ship manifest
lines: The ship comes every three months. Everything is checked: flour, fuel, post, tinned peaches, a goat.
If the ship is late, we make do. If the ship is very late, we make do with less.

papers.title: Stamp order
lines: Pitcairn stamps are collected the world over. The island sends a sheet of new ones every year.
The post office is a table, a book and a very organised woman.
